summary: TokenTracker is a local-first dashboard that tracks token usage and cost across AI coding tools. Saved views: (1) dashboard at / — summary stats, top models, activity heatmap, usage trend, totals split by provider and a daily breakdown table; (2) session-detail at /sessions — the sessions list loaded through the page's refresh button, because the first load showed an empty state, with one session's detail drawer open; (3) limits — rate-limit progress bars per provider; (4) skills — the installed agent skills list; (5) achievements — the badge grid. I also looked at Menu Bar & Widgets, a settings-style page with live previews, but didn't save it because only 5 views were allowed. I didn't explore Settings, Pet, Leaderboard (needs a cloud account), Wrapped, Claude IP Check or Service Status.
